item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

params.prompt_or_change: A clean fictional daily-planning app demo filling the frame, calm blue-and-white palette, scattered task cards with simple icons and abstract horizontal marks, visibly disorganized layout, minimalist flat interface, a clear uncluttered area at the top.

steps.why: Create the demo screen without requiring unreliable generated lettering.

params.prompt_or_change: Keep the camera fixed as scattered task cards smoothly align into a simple, spacious daily schedule with three neatly grouped sections; use gentle calm motion, preserve the blue-and-white interface, and settle into a stable organized screen at the end.

steps.why: Show the core transformation in one short animated shot.

params.extra: Play the five-second clip, then hold its final frame for three seconds; remove all audio.
params.prompt_or_change: Create a silent eight-second ad, preserving the transformation and holding the organized daily plan for the final three seconds.

steps.why: Make the exact eight-second ad with a calm final hold.
Guarantee that the ad ends with the exact, legible app name.
